page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 cloud server instance executing on KVM virtualization. The system is equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs provided by 4 physical Intel Xeon 8163 cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz with hyperthreading enabled. It includes 32.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per vCPU core), 33 MB of L3 cache, and a bundled 959 GB local SSD storage disk. Baseline network throughput is configured at 2 Gbps. Extended instruction flags supported by the processor include AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA.

Benchmark results demonstrate modest computational throughput across synthetic standard evaluation suites. Single-core and multi-core CPU metrics evaluated via stress-ng and Geekbench place in lower percentile tiers, with Geekbench registering 953.0 in single-core and 3596.0 in multi-core processing. PassMark testing reports an average CPU score of 7008.06 and an extended instruction score of 5880.83. Memory read bandwidth uncached measures 38.8 GB/sec, while large-block uncached write memory bandwidth reaches average levels at 35.51 GB/sec. Redis SET operation rate reaches 5.98 million operations per second, and static web serving achieves 4.55 GB/sec.

The inclusion of 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage along with 32 GB of memory provides localized storage capacity without requiring additional external volume attachments. Because CPU benchmark scores skew weak to average for computationally demanding applications, the instance presents tradeoffs for single-thread bound workloads. Its resource profile renders it appropriate for local database nodes, static web serving, caching layers, and general purpose applications requiring integrated local SSD storage.
